name: rehydrate
description: Restores task continuity after Codex context compaction.

interface.shortDescription: Recover task state after context compaction.
interface.longDescription: Rehydrate stays inactive before context compaction, then restores the active task state and selectively consults the persisted session record when later requests depend on earlier turns.
defaultPrompt: Use $rehydrate to recover the active task state for this session.
Continue this task using the relevant earlier session context.
